summary: Controls whether Veo generates synchronized speech, effects, and music on Vertex. The Gemini Developer API does not expose this switch and active Veo 3.1 models always generate audio there.
combines: Lixpi uses the Gemini Developer API, so the matrix must not show an audio toggle and the provider must not send generateAudio on that surface.
Audio safety filtering can block the whole generation; Google says blocked generations are not charged.
